description: 3hentai.net gallery page (/d/<id>), server-rendered Bootstrap layout of an nhentai mirror. Info block: div#main-info with an <h1><span class=middle-title> carrying the FULL bracketed title '(C103) [Circle (Artist)] Title (Series) [English] [Scanlator] [Digital]' (title rule must strip the event, circle/artist, parody, language, scanlator and Digital groups), a Japanese h2.subtitle, then nhentai-style div.tag-container rows whose label is a bare text node ('Series:', 'Characters:', 'Tags:', 'Artists:', 'Groups:', 'Languages:', 'Category:', 'Pages:', 'Uploaded:'); each entity is span.filter-elem > a.name with a PLURAL path (/tags/big-breasts, /artists/..., /groups/..., /series/..., /characters/..., dash slugs) whose text ends in a count badge span.tag-count '(168.2K)' / '(712)', followed by a filter button holding only an icon. Pages is a bare span; the upload date is only in <time datetime> (text is relative '9 months ago'). Cover is div#main-cover img.lazy with a placeholder src and the real URL in data-src (same as og:image). The bracketed scanlator '[Quill Jfzc]' is NOT a group and '(C103)' is an event, not a parody. Noise: navbar with Tags/Artists/Characters/Series/Groups index links, a Categories dropdown of format words and a Languages dropdown, search box, ExoClick/JuicyAds slots, 28 lazy thumbnails linking /d/<id>/<n>, a 'Related' grid of six cards whose titles name other circles/artists/parodies (one card is by the same circle about another character), and comments whose text contains fake row labels ('Artist: Quill Enys', 'Tags: netorare, ahegao', 'Pages: 28', 'Uploaded:') plus comment <time datetime> values later than the upload. Unsure of: 3hentai's exact class names (middle-title, filter-elem, tag-count, doujin-col), whether entity URLs use dash slugs or %20, whether counts are shown on the gallery page at all, the CDN host/file names (s5.3hentai.net/d<id>/cover.jpg, thumb.jpg, <n>t.jpg), the label wording ('Category' vs 'Categories'), and the comment markup; all names and ids are invented.
